question: The perimeter of a square whose area is the same as the area of a semi - circle of radius 2√2 cm is:
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the semi-circle = 2√2 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of semi-circle = (1/2) × π × r²

Area of square = side²

Perimeter of square = 4 × side

**Calculation:**

Area of semi-circle = (1/2) × π × (2√2)²

⇒ Area of semi-circle = (1/2) × π × 8 = 4π cm²

Now, since the area of the square is equal to the area of the semi-circle:

side² = 4π

⇒ side = √(4π) = 2√π cm

Perimeter of the square = 4 × 2√π = 8√π cm

**∴ The perimeter of the square is 8√π cm.**
